_source: Merged from claude-harness settings/permissions-deny.snippet.json and settings/git-hygiene.snippet.json on 2026-09-02. The rules are documented in claude-harness docs/git-hygiene.md; the project-specific TIGHTENING below is documented in AGENTS.md, which is where rule 13 says they belong.
_ss2_tightening: SS2 tightens rule 7. `Bash(git push *)` is in ASK, not allowed, because AGENTS.md says 'Ask before pushing anything' — this repository derives its fixtures from a licensed game, so what leaves the machine is the owner's call, not a convenience. Deny still beats ask, so main stays blocked outright and every other push prompts. Nothing is DENIED that has a legitimate form: a first draft also denied pushes to the working branch, which would have blocked work the owner had explicitly authorised.
_ss2_workflow: `Workflow` is in ASK so the owner approves each fan-out wave and sees what it spawns (harness docs/adr/0001). Bypass-permissions mode skips ASK rules by design, so under bypass the hard cap inside .claude/workflows/question-fanout-audit.js is the only deterministic guard.
